full_judgment: 4. The defendant contested the suit by filing a written statement denying all material allegations made in plaint contending inter alia that suit premises situated in the ground floor of Municipal holding No. 68, Shakhari Bazar, Dhaka, which is a six-storied building and besides the suit premises there are seven shops in the ground floor, of which one shop is under khas possession of plaintiff and rest are rented to different tenants. In 1973, he was inducted into the suit premises as a tenant at the rent of Taka 100 per month, on payment of Taka 7,500 to plaintiff as advance. Rent was subsequently enhanced to Taka 300 per month. Later on, for the cause of repair, he handed over possession to plaintiff and further paid Taka 32,500 as advance. Pursuant to agreement dated 28-7-1987. Afterwards, possession was restored to him but advance money for Taka 7,500 + 32,500 = 40,000, was neither adjusted nor refunded to him, however, he was paying rent regularly up to Ashar 1402 BS. Since Sravan 1402 BS the plaintiff refused to accept the rent. Since then he is depositing rent to House Rent Controller in House Rent Case No. 117 of 1985. He is not a defaulter in payment of rent rather his Taka 40,000 paid as advance to plaintiff is still lying with him. Moreso, plaintiff has no bonafide requirement of suit premises. Thus the suit having no cause of action is liable to be dismissed.
